text.id: Nak Raka, ini Tante Wulan, ibunya Sekar. Nomornya Tante dapat dari Dinda.
text.en: Raka dear, this is Auntie Wulan, Sekar's mother. Dinda gave me your number.

text.id: Maaf Tante belum bisa keluar kamar. Tante dengar suaramu dari tadi pagi. Terima kasih sudah datang jauh-jauh.
text.en: I'm sorry I haven't been able to leave my room. I've heard your voice since this morning. Thank you for coming all this way.

text.id: Sekar dulu sering cerita soal kamu. Setahun ini juga. Dia bilang, "Raka itu kalau takut suka lari, Bu. Tapi dia selalu balik."
text.en: Sekar used to talk about you a lot. This past year too. She said, "Raka runs when he's scared, Mom. But he always comes back."

text.id: Gue pernah janji ini. Entah di mana, entah kapan. Rasanya kayak ngulang kalimat yang udah pernah gue ucapin, dan kali ini gue lebih serius.
text.en: I've made this promise before. I don't know where, or when. It feels like repeating something I've already said, and this time I mean it more.

text.id: Saya bakal cari Sekar sampai ketemu, Tante.
text.en: I'll keep looking for Sekar until I find her, Auntie.

text.id: Maaf saya baru dateng sekarang, Tante.
text.en: I'm sorry it took me this long to come, Auntie.

text.id: Tante istirahat dulu. Dinda biar saya yang temenin.
text.en: Please get some rest, Auntie. I'll keep Dinda company.

text.id: Tante titip Dinda ya, Nak. Dia sok kuat, sama kayak kakaknya.
text.en: Please look after Dinda for me. She pretends to be strong, just like her sister.
